ideas.pitch: An automated incubation assessment platform that ingests GitHub repositories of student capstone projects, parses their architecture, evaluates code quality, and generates a commercialization readiness score along with a pitch deck outline.
ideas.title: ProducTier: Academic Project to Market Validator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the central theme of HTF 3.0, 'Project to Product', addressing the judges' explicit goal of finding solutions with real-world usability, scalability, and incubation potential.

ideas.pitch: A verification platform for university students to mint cryptographically secure credentials for hackathon projects and mini-projects, allowing local industries and startup incubators in Dehradun to source verified engineering talent.
ideas.title: SkillTrace: Micro-Internship & Industry Talent Passport
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the incubation opportunities, mentorship, and internship opportunities promoted by Tula's University for this national hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite and document analysis tool designed for state industrial development corporations to automatically monitor environmental compliance and land usage in industrial corridors.
ideas.title: EcoAudit AI: Regional Industrial Land Compliance Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the technical and architectural success of regional compliance monitoring hacks that win awards by solving tangible government and enterprise auditing pain points.

ideas.pitch: A localized web application that helps small healthcare clinics in tier-2 and tier-3 Indian cities automate patient onboarding, verified reviews generation, and multilingual care follow-ups.
ideas.title: ClinTrust AI: Patient Acquisition & Trust Engine for Local Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven high-converting formula of verticalized trust and patient acquisition engines built for real-world service providers.

ideas.pitch: An automated risk-scoring dashboard for regional micro-enterprises combining transaction graph intelligence and explainable machine learning models to secure micro-loans from partner banks.
ideas.title: RiskLens: SME Supply Chain AML & Credit Risk Scoring Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering via graph intelligence and risk scoring, matching the caliber of top financial innovation hackathon winners.
